__meta__.label: exploratory_post_open
__meta__.plain_language: Post-hoc uncertainty analysis of an exploratory result. Not a confirmation. Nothing here may be moved into a headline.

definitions.joint_bootstrap: whole networks resampled with replacement; every width, axis and contrast in a grid shares the same resample within a draw, so cross-width correlations are preserved
definitions.crossover: smallest width at which a contrast curve first turns non-positive after being positive. The interpolated value is the log-width interpolation used by scripts/215_v18_support_width.py::crossover, restricted to + -> <= 0
definitions.p_no_crossover: fraction of replicates whose contrast curve never turns non-positive after being positive within the nine swept widths; the reason counts split it into never_positive_in_range, advantage_gained_later_not_lost and positive_at_every_width
definitions.scale_refit: the frozen rule fixes each endpoint's tolerance at 0.5/1.06 x its full-development interannual sd; the refit sensitivity re-estimates that scale inside each replicate

contrast_notes.support_restricted_minus_missing_fractio: The E6 P1 contrast: the re-seeked support-restricted axis (share of the estimand's own climatological hottest-k window that the outage hides) minus the whole-year missing fraction. At k = 365 the two coincide by construction, except on leap years (see validation).
contrast_notes.fixed_peak_window_30_minus_missing_fract: The E6 P2 contrast and the source of the reported 91-day / 119-day crossover: a FIXED 30-day climatological peak-window overlap minus the whole-year missing fraction, evaluated against the label at each endpoint width k. The axis does not vary with k; only the label does. This is therefore not a statement about window width at all.
contrast_notes.support_restricted_minus_fixed_peak_wind: The re-seeked support axis minus the fixed 30-day peak axis.
contrast_notes.longest_run_minus_missing_fraction: The v17 'length' axis (longest single outage run) against mean missingness.
contrast_notes.fixed_centre_dilation_minus_reseeking: F05 falsification test. Both axes are window-hidden fractions at the same width; the left one dilates a window held at the training-period climatological peak centre, the right one re-seeks the hottest k-day window in the same climatology. They are identical at width 30 by construction.
contrast_notes.fixed_centre_dilation_raw_peak_minus_mis: Dilation of the raw training-year climatological peak window (the window peak_overlap uses) against the whole-year missing fraction.

regenerated_masks_vs_stored.leap_year_note: in a 366-day year the width-365 re-seeking window covers 365 of 366 days, so the axis is not exactly the whole-year missing fraction there; this is inherited from endpoints.hottest_k_window and is why the point contrast at k=365 is -0.0006 rather than exactly zero

support_restricted_minus_missing_fractio.note: the raw leave-one-out range is not a confidence interval: removing one of 110 networks leaves 99% of the data, so it understates sampling variability by roughly sqrt(n_networks). The jackknife SE and its normal CI are the comparable quantities
